name: IETF
body: Framing is denied, every page analyzed has a meta description, and Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors. But /.well-known/security.txt answers 404, so a researcher has no published place to report a flaw.
lesson: Publish /.well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires lines, per RFC 9116.
summary: www.ietf.org scores 84 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 17 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 80 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /about/, /about/introduction/, /about/groups/iesg/ and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: 20 indexable pages are missing from the sitemap
fix.fix: Add them to the sitemap or regenerate it on each deploy.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 165 ms
Every page has a meta description
